Container.Name: Recovery-Curator
Container.Overview: Non-destructive recovery triage for exact duplicates, similar photos, corrupt/zero-byte files, filename-derived photo dates, categorized exports, and AI-ready catalogs.
Container.Requires: Build the included image once with install-unraid.sh. Keep Source Access read-only and ALLOW_ACTIONS=false for the first scan.

Config.Name: Recovered Source
Config.Description: Top-level directory containing recovered files. Do not map both /mnt/user and individual /mnt/disk paths for the same files.

Config.Name: Curated Output
Config.Description: New categorized library. Source files are copied here; filename-derived metadata is applied only to these copies.

Config.Name: Quarantine
Config.Description: Reversible holding area for files explicitly quarantined after review.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite catalog, scan state, and reports. Prefer cache storage.

Config.Name: Allow Write Actions
Config.Description: Leave false for scanning/review. Set true only when ready to build the curated output or quarantine files.

Config.Name: Analysis Workers
Config.Description: One worker is optimized for this recovery set residing on a single pool drive.

Config.Name: Hash Workers
Config.Description: One sequential full-file reader prevents seek contention on the single source drive.

Config.Name: Checkpoint Batch
Config.Description: Maximum in-memory work batch and checkpoint interval. 64 is recommended.

Config.Name: Photo Similarity Distance
Config.Description: Perceptual hash distance from 0-16. Six is conservative; higher creates broader groups.
